prg3565.title: FOCAL-Workshop: Producing Low-Budget Feature Films in Europe
prg3565.synopsis: How are ambitious animated films made on a budget of less than €4 million? Marcel Barelli (CH), Anca Damian (RO) and Chorok Mouaddib (FR) share their experiences, production methods and creative strategies for balancing artistic ambition with financial constraints.

prg4328.title: Fantoche Shop 2026
prg4328.synopsis: Fantoche T-shirts and bags, films, books, gadgets and gimmicks and a selection of rarities are available for purchase in the festival shop.

films.title: Display Nature
films.credit: Display Nature, Nicolas Gebbe, DE 2026
films.synopsis: Blending CGI collages, photogrammetry and real footage, “Display Nature” explores how urban and digital spaces mirror our ideas of nature and ourselves. A reflection on perception, the absurdities of commodification and the disconnect within artificial modern life. “Shape nature to shape yourself.”

films.title: Two Ice Creams Please
films.credit: Two Ice Creams Please, Jasmine Elsen, BE 2026
films.synopsis: During their holiday, two young women get lost in a rainforest. After wandering around for days, their irritation with one another grows. While increasingly dreaming about ice cream, they become conscious of their own vulnerability.

films.title: L’escargot gaucher
films.credit: The Left-Handed Snail, Matteo Boulard, Clément Nahmias, Louis Velaine, Valentin Decombes, Gabryël Aury, Mathys Mysius , FR 2025
films.synopsis: A left-handed snail, unable to reproduce with right-handed snails, sets off on a long journey to find love. An animal documentary that truly touches the heart.

films.title: Birdcalls
films.credit: Birdcalls, Malcolm Sutherland, CA 2005
films.synopsis: A telephone answering machine is activated and all the messages it contains are played. We hear the sounds of twelve different birds and see a hand trying to find signs, symbols, letters to contain what has been uttered. The symbols evolve to a language of far more than just the sounds of birds.

films.title: Hungry Hollow
films.credit: Hungry Hollow, Sarah Franny Ruyle, US 2025
films.synopsis: A group of forest spirits meet by the pond and gleefully go about their mischief.

films.title: Kenopsia
films.credit: Kenopsia, Mohamed Omar, EG 2023
films.synopsis: An old man drives back to the now abandoned city of Cairo in order to reach his old home that he remembers from childhood. Longing for his homeland, he takes us on a short journey through the decayed city of Cairo, which becomes the actual protagonist.

films.title: To Kill a Velofahrer
films.credit: To Kill a Velofahrer, Helmi Korhonen, Ines Nungaesser, Livio Frauendor, Marvin Bueeler, CH 2026
films.synopsis: A proud urban planner defends his “visionary” cycle lane designs to his superiors. On the streets outside the conference room, his “perfect” plans plunge the city into chaos.

films.title: Sun Ra's Calling Planet Earth With the OVC
films.credit: Sun Ra's Calling Planet Earth with the OVC, Bill Sebastian, US 1986
films.synopsis: Bill Sebastian’s Outer Space Visual Communicator (OVC) was constructed from lights, mirrors, projectors and video effect and mixing equipment, and could be played like a live instrument with hands, feet and even the mouth! Here we get a glimpse of the OVC’s kaleidoscopic visual effects, which were used by the Sun Ra Arkestra to “visualize soundwaves” as part of their touring cosmic stage show.

prg3412.title: Light Pillar
prg3412.synopsis: Set in the nottoo- distant future, janitor Zha is busy maintaining an abandoned film studio with the help of his cat. He escapes this bleak reality by increasingly immersing himself in a virtual world. Combining laconic humour and low-res, live-action footage, Zao Xu’s feature-film debut tells a story of loneliness and unfulfilled desires.

films.title: Sensual
films.credit: Sensual, Tanja Nuijten, DE 2025
films.synopsis: Soft snails glide lasciviously across moist lips, smooth snakes slip gently through fingers, a warm bear hug. Sensual touches on a body, stimulated by various claws, furs, scales and more. Tender, vulnerable, powerful and sexy.

films.title: Keko & Kiki
films.credit: Keko & Kiki, Mauro Carraro, CH 2025
films.synopsis: The cheeky crow Keko and the well-behaved hunting dog Kiki are the pets of an elderly couple in a small village in north-eastern Italy. Apart from a few squabbles, they live together peacefully. Their world is shaken when a big argument breaks out.

films.title: Chaos Ex Machina
films.credit: Chaos Ex Machina, Zoltan Horvath, CH 2025
films.synopsis: “Where do we want to go?” This question does not come from an ancient Greek philosopher but from a dysfunctional, nihilistic GPS device. Switch on at your own risk. An attempt to follow a constantly changing route and not end up in the scenery.

films.title: My Peckham Experiment
films.credit: My Peckham Experiment, Gerd Gockell, CH/DE 2026
films.synopsis: Everything trembles, everything vibrates, the rhythm runs through the neighbourhood. A visual experiment about shifting perspectives and a declaration of love for a London district.

films.title: Cartoon Physics
films.credit: Cartoon Physics, Ru Kuwahata, Max Porter, CH/DE/NL 2026
films.synopsis: A dead bird in the garden raises questions for a four-year-old. To protect her daughter from harsh reality, a mother invents an alternative world. Together, they escape into the logic of cartoons, where anything is possible.

films.title: What's Your Verdict ?
films.credit: What's your verdict? Persephone Huynh Murphy, Anna Paziewska, Marija Gajic, CH 2026
films.director: Persephone Huynh Murphy, Anna Paziewska, Marija Gajic
films.synopsis: A TV courtroom show: a man, a woman, one evening together, contradictory versions of what happened. Broadcast disruption –we’ll return to the programme shortly. Who is telling the truth and whom do you believe?

films.title: Was glitzert
films.credit: What Glitters, Anna Lena Spring, Lara Perren, CH 2026
films.synopsis: In a magical world full of strawberries, dreamer Glitzeri creates beautiful, sparkling water fountains. But his happiness is dampened by the other animals. If only they could recognise the beauty hidden beneath the surface.

films.title: Miserere Mei
films.credit: Miserere Mei, Valentine Moser, CH 2025
films.synopsis: The beguiling sound of a dystopian universe in which hope even shines through radioactive deers.

films.title: Stärneschii
films.credit: Stärneschii, Jérémie Jayraj Itt, Inna Sorok, Julia Estrada Torre, Sammi Khuu, CH 2026
films.director: Jérémie Jayraj Itty, Inna Soroka, Julia Estrada Torres, Sammi Khuu
films.synopsis: Joakim works with great dedication in the dementia ward. His care is appreciated. But the young man struggles with the emotional strain of his work and must learn to accept the limits to what he can give.

films.title: The Picture of Dorian Gray
films.credit: The Picture of Dorian Gray, Georges Schwizgebel, CH 2026
films.synopsis: Through the magic of a wish, Dorian Gray retains the beauty of youth. Only his painted portrait will age. Now he is to enjoy life to the fullest. Based on the novel by Oscar Wilde.

films.title: Trouvé !
films.credit: Found !, Juliette Baily, BE/FE 2025
films.synopsis: Anna sets off for a walk in the snow. Along the way, she meets a mischievous little bunny who whisks her away on a joyful winter adventure. Amid wild chases and games of hide-and-seek, this gentle outing turns into a magical experience.

films.title: Bats & Bugs
films.credit: Bats & Bugs, Lena von Döhren, CH 2026
films.synopsis: When a light goes on in the middle of the jungle, the insects are thrown into turmoil – much to the delight of the hungry bats nearby! With plenty of humour and poetry, this nocturnal adventure raises awareness of light pollution.

films.title: Little Dandelion
films.credit: Little Dandelion, Adéla Honová, CZ 2026
films.synopsis: Carried by the wind, a dandelion seed drifts through an enchanting forest. Along the way, it learns to let go of its fears and comes to understand that an ending does not always have to be sad but can also mean a wonderful new beginning.

films.title: The Lamp Collector
films.credit: The Lamp Collector, Sonya Bergquist, US 2025
films.synopsis: Little vixen Elsie is a nocturnal animal,however loves the light of the sun. So, in the darkness, she collects lamps and lights to conjure a little glow in her den. This tender film shows us how much magic can be found in the most ordinary things.

films.title: Vers la forêt
films.credit: Into the Forest, Antonin Niclass, CH 2026
films.synopsis: In an animation studio, a little monkey comes to life. When he sees a beautiful, glowing jungle on a monitor, his thirst for adventure takes hold and, together with two friends, he builds a world of his own. The film illustrates the power that the imagination can unleash.

films.title: A Sunny Story
films.credit: A Sunny Story, Masha Rumyantseva, PT/RU 2026
films.synopsis: A small, daydreaming squirrel wishes for nothing more than the sun to never stop shining. But when the rain really disappears forever, nature begins to suffer ... This story shows us why we need the sun and rain in equal measure.

films.title: The Glutton
films.credit: The Glutton, Chris McDonnell, US 2026
films.synopsis: A very, very, very greedy character devours everything in its path ... preferably the tiniest of creatures! Where will it all end? A funny and surprising story, rhythmically accompanied by witty sound effects made with the mouth.

films.title: Aller & Retour
films.credit: Aller & Retour, Lucia Bulgheroni, Michele Greco, IT 2025
films.synopsis: Just in time for the start of winter, two little stoats face a big task: they have toswap their brown summer coats for white winter fur. But as if that wasn’t difficult enough, a hunter suddenly appears and everything becomes even more complicated.

films.title: Derring-Do
films.credit: Derring-Do, Elena Walf, HR/DE 2025
films.synopsis: Spurred on by its two siblings, the smallest chick dares to peek into mysterious, dark holes. What if the scariest places are actually hiding the most wonderful surprises?

films.title: Pelle - Friends Don't Sink
films.credit: Pelle - Friends Don't Sink, Romana Bauer, Sophia Galneder, Leo Semmelmann, DE 2025
films.director: Romana Bauer, Sophia Galneder, Leo Semmelmann
films.synopsis: On an iceberg at the end of the world, Pelle waits every year for his friend Ole the Whale. But this time, Ole doesn’t arrive on the agreed day. Growing impatient, Pelle decides to lure his friend with loud whale songs. This has unintended consequences and sends the two pals on an adventurous journey. A heart-warming story about loyal friendship!

prg3399.title: Panorama Reality Check
prg3399.synopsis: Looking for a reality check? Whether it’s escaping a threatening home environment and entering a new world (“Gently”), grappling with family structures (“Our Walls”, “The Amazing Adam”), a revelation that alters the fabric of reality (“Ploo”), the fight for more women’s equal rights (“Virgin Fandango”), a traumatic event that casts doubt on one’s own behaviour (“Pinchu is like that”), or a supernatural encounter in a mysterious high-rise (“Dawn at Terezinha Building”): either willingly or unwillingly, the protagonists in the “Panorama Reality Check” programme find themselves confronting new insights, unexpected revelations and the limits of their own perceptions.

films.title: Dawn at Terezinha Building
films.credit: Dawn at Terezinha Building, Cesar Cabral, Renato José Duque, BR 2026
films.synopsis: It’s late night in São Paulo. Álvaro takes a job caring for a terminally ill patient – but death seeps through the rooms of the mysterious old building.

films.title: Pinchu Is Like That
films.credit: Pinchu Is Like That, Carmen Cordóba González, ES 2025
films.synopsis: Pinchu is pervy, and everyone laughs off his antics – including his girlfriend Jimena, who’s turning 30 and throwing an epic party. Only Bea sees him for what he really is, though this traumatic experience may make her question whether she has been excusing the behaviour of someone she loves in the same way.

films.title: Gently
films.credit: Gently, Jamaica Kindlová, CZ 2026
films.synopsis: Charcoal animation reveals the fear of home through the eyes of a little boy who must remain constantly on alert and ready to escape.

films.title: Ploo
films.credit: Ploo, Jon Frickey, DE 2025
films.synopsis: “Ploo”combines mathematics, vector graphics and the aesthetics of early video games to create a fascinating audiovisual experience. Between abstract structure and playful dynamics, the film unfolds as a work that both challenges and enchants.

films.title: Virgin Fandango
films.credit: Virgin Fandango, Marcy Page, CA 2026
films.synopsis: A short musical, using a novel technique of animated azulejos (painted tiles), in which a rebellious Mary joins her voice with those of celebrated women of history in the struggle for equality.

films.title: Our Walls
films.credit: Our Walls, Živa Divjak, SI 2026

films.title: The Amazing Adam!
films.credit: The Amazing Adam!, Areito Echevarria, NZ 2025
films.synopsis: A young boy explores the darkest depths of his grumpy grandfather’s garage, where he’s confronted by the surreal memories of the man he thought he knew.

prg3527.title: REFRESH x Fantoche #5
prg3527.synopsis: We live in a time when not only humans and other living beings sense and respond, but machines are also developing a life of their own and may even learn to act independently and intentionally. How can design and the arts, in dialogue with other disciplines, provide access to these often hidden, highly complex processes? The group exhibition “REFRESH x Fantoche. Ways into Being” approaches the fragile moment – when something stirs, when life emerges and when it first interacts with its environment – through games, digital playful experiments, sculptural installations and video works, both with critical observation and with humour. Featuring international artists such as Vectorpark, AATB, David OReilly, Studio Eidola and Amanita Design. REFRESH x Fantoche is a collaboration between the Department of Design and the Immersive Arts Space at Zurich University of the Arts and Fantoche.

prg3577.title: Museum Langmatt: Sustainability Tour
prg3577.synopsis: Sustainability is evident in many different ways at Langmatt Museum. As part of its comprehensive renovation, the historic building was made more energy-efficient; a photovoltaic system on the new pavilion generates renewable energy. In the park, various stations forming part of the ‘Was lebt im Park?’ project (‘What’s living in the park?’), developed in collaboration with the City of Baden’s Urban Ecology Department, invite visitors to discover biodiversity.

prg3539.title: 90 Years of Egyptian Animation: The Pioneers
prg3539.synopsis: In 2026, we are celebrating 90 years of Egyptian animation and its pioneers: the Frenkel brothers, creators of Egypt’s first animated films and characters who captured the essence, music and humour of Egypt; the Moheeb brothers, who shaped its studios, TV and advertising; and other artists whose works are still making an impression on Egyptian pop culture today.

films.title: Mafich Faïda
films.credit: Mafich Faïda, Frenkel Brothers, EG 1936
films.director: Herschel Frenkel, Salomon Frenkel, David Frenkel
films.synopsis: Poor Mich Mich Effendi is trying to capture the heart of a beautiful lady but there are far too many obstacles waiting for him.

films.title: Mish Mish Effendi in National Defence
films.credit: Mish Mish Effendi in National Defence, Frenkel Brothers, EG 1938
films.director: Herschel Frenkel, Salomon Frenkel, David Frenkel
films.synopsis: War breaks out abruptly and Mich Mich Effendi immediately answers the call to arms to defend his beloved homeland.

films.title: Tête dure
films.credit: Tête Dure, Frenkel Brothers, EG 1941
films.director: Herschel Frenkel, Salomon Frenkel, David Frenkel
films.synopsis: A lamppost struggles with the noise and chaos of Egypt’s new motorists.

films.title: Masrool Ad (Ali Baba)
films.credit: Masrool Ad (Ali Baba), Brothers Moheeb, EG 1967
films.director: Ali Moheeb, Hossam El Deen Moheeb
films.synopsis: The poor Ali Baba gets rich after discovering treasure but now he faces an even bigger problem. Advertisement for a detergent from the Misr Petroleum Company.

films.title: Sigal Ad (Pharaoh Speaks)
films.credit: Sigal Ad (Pharaoh Speaks), Brothers Moheeb, EG 1968
films.director: Ali Moheeb, Hossam El Deen Moheeb
films.synopsis: The pharaohs rise from their tombs to witness a wonder far greater than their treasures. Advertisement from the Sigal metal company.

films.title: Masr Ice Cream Ad (Where did Ramses go?)
films.credit: Masr Ice Cream Ad (Where did Ramses go?), Brothers Moheeb, EG 1968
films.director: Ali Moheeb, Hossam El Deen Moheeb
films.synopsis: The disappearnce of the statue of Ramses II from his square causes a stir. Where could he have gone? Advertisement for Misr company for dairy products.

films.title: Milk Ad (She's Wrong)
films.credit: Milk Ad (She's Wrong), Brothers Moheeb, EG 1968
films.director: Ali Moheeb, Hossam El Deen Moheeb
films.synopsis: A well-meaning mother makes a mistake and is corrected by her doctor. Advertisement for the Misr Dairy and Food Company.

films.title: Family Planning Ad 1
films.credit: Family Planning Ad 1, Brothers Moheeb, EG 1968
films.director: Ali Moheeb, Hossam El Deen Moheeb
films.synopsis: A family of two gets bigger and bigger – when will it stop? Advertisement for family planning products from Gomhoureya Pharmaceuticals.

films.title: Family Planning Ad 2
films.credit: Family Planning Ad 2, Brothers Moheeb, EG 1982
films.director: Ali Moheeb, Hossam El Deen Moheeb
films.synopsis: Farmers in the fields and fishers in the sea notice a paper flying around in the sky. What could it be? Advertisement for the national family planning campaign.

films.title: Dexan Ad
films.credit: Dexan Ad, Brothers Moheeb, EG 1978
films.director: Ali Moheeb, Hossam El Deen Moheeb
films.synopsis: A message from the leader of the cockroaches to his brothers and sisters. Advertisement for Dexan cockroach repellent aerosol.

films.title: Bentlyes Ad
films.credit: Bentlyes Ad, Brothers Moheeb, EG 1986
films.director: Ali Moheeb, Hossam El Deen Moheeb
films.synopsis: A sick and tired teapot is given a recipe for better health and good flavour. Advertisement for Bentlyes tea.

films.credit: 1 & 5, Noshy Iskandar, EG 1974
films.synopsis: Five monkeys steal one man’s greatest possession. Will he be able to get it back?

films.title: Un, deux, trois...
films.credit: Un, deux, trois..., Ihab Shaker, EG 1974
films.synopsis: In three short stories, a man discovers a shower, a bird and a machine. What could possibly go wrong?

films.title: Semsema the Dancer
films.credit: Semsema the Dancer, Fayza Abo Hussein, EG 1989
films.synopsis: Famous belly dancer Semsema puts on a show for her fans and dances to the Egyptian darbuka beats.

films.title: Birthday of the Wagtail
films.credit: Birthday of the Wagtail, Ahmed Saad, EG 1991
films.synopsis: The Crow invites the birds of the garden to a night of dancing in celebration of the Wagtail’s birthday, the most beloved of all the birds.

films.title: Marble & Lemons
films.credit: Marble & Lemons, Anna Katalin Lovrity FR/HR 2026
films.synopsis: During a vacation on the Italian coast, a sophisticated lady and her free-spirited adult daughter struggle to connect. When the daughter discovers her mother’s vulnerability, she starts to see her in a new light. “Marble & Lemons” is an ode to physical changes, femininityand sorority.

films.title: My Brother, My Brother
films.credit: My Brother, My Brother, Abdelrahman Dnewar, Saad Dnewar, EG 2025
films.synopsis: “My Brother, My Brother” is anautofictional story following identical twins Omar and Wesam as they navigate a childhood shaped by faith, science and loss. Through fragmented memories and shifting perspectives, the film explores grief, identity and the fragile bond that connects them.

films.title: « Ce n’est pas sale »
films.credit: « Ce n’est pas sale », Ulysse Patrick Thevenot, FR 2025
films.synopsis: Didier remembers. In the intimacy of his daily life, he recounts his memories of love and loneliness, of what is hidden and whatremains. The film questions how memories build our identity, while raising awareness of the struggles and hardships that queer seniors face throughout their lives.

films.title: Uka-Uka
films.credit: Uka-Uka, Henri Veermäe, EE 2026
films.synopsis: Battling boredom, a little boy gets trapped in the boot of a car. When he gets out, he’s no longer the same.

films.title: School Show
films.credit: School Show, Ana Horvat, HR 2026
films.synopsis: In mid-1980s Yugoslavia, a school performance is underway. As songs and recitations unfold on stage, a young Pioneer girl notices an unfamiliar man in the audience behaving in a strange and unsettling way – something she cannot fully understand.

films.title: A Taste of Beer
films.credit: A Taste of Beer, Xie Li, CN 2026

films.title: If the Stars Were to Light Up
films.credit: If the Stars Were to Light up, Andrea Odreman, Emiliano Campos, AR 2025
films.synopsis: In a hot, deserted neighbourhood on the outskirts of the city, three kids and a dog rest in the shade of a tree. Everything hums like a thick, drowsy tranquillity, but the calm is broken by small cracks in the everyday. Suddenly, astrange light floods everything and time seems to shatter. A visual poem about waiting and restlessness.

films.title: Im Auto Tapes und Butterbrot
films.credit: With Tapes and Toasts in the Car, Kiana Naghshineh, DE 2025
films.synopsis: During a visit to the doctor, Shari learns that an affliction is causing her body to fade into stardust. She begins to realise what truly matters to her.

prg3548.title: 98’856 Frames of Bonding
prg3548.synopsis: If only we could dance like a flower, draw nourishment from Mother Nature’s bosom, decipher the language of the birds and live in harmony with nature! In “Birdcalls”, an attempt is made to decode the songbirds’ message using an answering machine; in “Eager”, human bodies morph into floral patterns as part of a bizarre choreography and in “La saison pourpre”, childhood is poetically evoked as a place of naturalness.

films.title: Abandoned Village
films.credit: Abandoned Village, Mariam Kapanadze, GE 2020
films.synopsis: An archetypal portrait of every place that has been abandoned, where the village becomes a living being, first left alone by men and then illuminated by the light of a fire that evokes a possible return, in the eternal repetition of the before and after of life and death.

films.title: Weval – Someday
films.credit: Weval – Someday, IE 2019
films.synopsis: The fragility of Earth's future, the uncertainty of life are among the core concepts director Páraic McGloughlin explores in this music video for Weval, a duo from the Kompakt label.

films.title: In a Dumpster
films.credit: In a Dumpster, Daria Kashcheeva, CZ 2017
films.synopsis: What happens in the dustbin when no one’s watching? What if, unknowingly, we’re creating new life with our waste? And will that life be peaceful, or will it try to destroy us?

films.title: Birdcalls
films.credit: Birdcalls, Malcolm Sutherland, CA 2005
films.synopsis: A telephone answering machine is activated and all the messages it contains are played. We hear the sounds of twelve different birds and see a hand trying to find signs, symbols, letters to contain what has been uttered. The symbols evolve to a language of far more than just the sounds of birds.

films.title: The Flood is Coming
films.credit: The Flood is Coming, Gabriel Böhmer, GB/CH 2018_02
films.synopsis: A forest hermit tries to prepare for a flood, but he becomes distracted by his noisy neighbour – who happens to be the hermit's left eye. The film explores the growing anxiety about the state of nature, and our place in it.

films.title: Eager
films.credit: Eager, Allison Schulnik, UK 2014
films.synopsis: A Claymation dance film by Allison Schulnik, who makes beautiful, eerie work. In Eager, fairy-like clay beings perform a discomforting choreography. First in the dark, then in a field of flowers. There the violets and roses join in and they are creepier than you can imagine.

films.title: La saison pourpre
films.credit: The Purple Season, Clémence Bouchereau, FR 2023
films.synopsis: On an island at the edge of the mangrove, a group of girlslives to the rhythm of the climate. Heloise, the youngest, is timidly discovering her new environment. Lucia, who is entering puberty, hunts wild geese to feed the group. Sarah, who is younger than Lucia, seems more and more ready to succeed her.

films.title: Oh Willy…
films.credit: Oh Willy…, Emma DeSwaef, Marc James Roels, BE 2012
films.director: Emma De Swaef, Marc James Roels
films.synopsis: Fifty-something Willy returns to the naturist community of his youth to visit his dying mother. When she dies shortly after he arrives, Willy flees in confused sadness into the forest. After a rough start he finds the motherly protection of a big gentle hairy beast.

films.title: Ivar
films.credit: Ivar, Markus Tangre, NO 2025
films.synopsis: Bothered by her husband Ivar’s intolerable new scent, Anne lies awake at night with a nagging question: should she leave him?

films.title: Decay
films.credit: Decay, Juan Camilo González, CO 2025
films.synopsis: Gunpowder is used to celebrate and to kill in Colombia. A director is burdened by a violent act that touches his family and his art.

films.title: Famous Mouse and Joan of Arc
films.credit: Famous Mouse and Joan of Arc, Igor Simić, RS 2026
films.synopsis: Mickey Mouse has a religious vision in which Joan of Arc sends him on a mission to save our souls.

films.title: Tar
films.credit: Tar, Fariba Farzanfar, IR 2026
films.synopsis: “Tar” is an experimental animation made with real hair. In Persian, “tar” means both a strand of hair and a traditional string instrument. As an enraged centipede invades a girl’s inner world, destroying instruments, the fragile sound of the tar opens a path to transformation.

films.title: Sundruð
films.credit: Sundruð, Fan Sissoko, BE/FR/IS 2026
films.synopsis: Neema, a young immigrant in Iceland, takes socially awkward trips to a local swimming pool. The more she tries to fit in, the more isolated she feels, until she finds a common bond with an older woman struggling with loneliness and grief.

films.title: If the Turtles Could Fly
films.credit: If the Turtles Could Fly, Hayat Laban, PS 2025
films.synopsis: Twenty years after a picture unsettled her childhood, a Palestinian filmmaker returns to where it all began, stepping into a blurred space where imagination and reality meet in her search for safety.

films.title: Foreign Bodies
films.credit: Foreign Bodies, Lysander Wong, UK 2025
films.synopsis: A simple itch compounds into an outbreak that tears asunder a body in transformation. Certain forms will always find their way to the surface.

films.title: HAG
films.credit: HAG, Anna Ginsburg, UK 2025
films.synopsis: After breaking up with her obnoxious boyfriend, what should be a moment of liberation instead transforms ourheroine into a hag with snakes for hair. Battling societal pressures, she searches for love and meaning in a hellscape of waning fertility and the rotten stench of patriarchy.

prg3568.title: Guetnachtgschichtli: Nussbaumbandi
prg3568.synopsis: “Nussbaumbandi” is the latest Swiss bedtime story series comprising 26 episodes, each of which are 5 minutes long. The first episodes will celebrate their world premiere with a screening at Fantoche. High up in an old walnut tree is Yoko, Vikram and Silóe’s treehouse – the place where they meet to start their adventures. Together with the animals who share this overgrown, green space, they roam a small urban wilderness full of streams, meadows and hidden places. In their small, enchanted world, curiosity, solidarity and friendship matter more than anything else.

prg3562.title: Born in the Jungle
prg3562.synopsis: Nine-yearold Elisabeth would actually prefer to spend the summer in the city. But when her little brother disappears in the Venezuelan rainforest, she discovers a truly mystical world. Using child-friendly imagery, Edmunds Jansons tells a story of courage and a mysterious mythical creature.

prg3536.title: Meet the Artist: Cheng-Hsu Chung
prg3536.synopsis: Cheng-Hsu Chung is a Taiwanese animation artist and director currently based in Berlin, Germany. Chung’s artistic practice focuses on using surreal imagery and character performances in animation to articulate the changing nature of emotions, modern romantic relationships and the experiences of queer bodies in today’s queer culture. Working across artistic and commercial contexts, Chung has merged both worlds and created his playful, surreal visual style. As an animation artist and illustrator, his work adds artistry and originality to commercial projects while maintaining a distinctive signature style. His clients include Spotify, Adidas, Nike, Adult Swim, BBC, Warp Records, Bayer, Berliner Zeitung, among many others.

prg3544.title: Gluri Suter Huus: Lost Spaces
prg3544.synopsis: In addition to the exhibitions “Fading Utopia” by Jan Sebesta and “Gärten – Urbane Natur” by Urban Sketchers, Fantoche is presenting a selection of four short films in the gallery at Gluri Suter Huus. Alternating between earnestness and subtle irony, the films address ecology, identity, trauma and perception as permanently changing states.

films.title: All My Scars Vanish in the Wind
films.credit: All My Scars Vanish in the Wind, Carlos David Velandia, María Angélica Restrepo Guzmán, CO 2022
films.director: Carlos David Velandia, María Angélica Restrepo Guzmán
films.synopsis: A woman hears a disturbing callcoming from within and follows it as far as her inner child. Atmospheric images and the absence of conventional narrative structures create an intense, dreamlike experience, depicting vulnerability, memory and inner transformation.

films.title: House of Existence
films.credit: House of Existence, Yu-mi Joung, KR 2022
films.synopsis: The film centres on a dilapidated house, a metaphor for inner and outer decay: structures are collapsing, memories and belongings fading and falling apart, until one person is left alone among the ruins. Using a symbolic, at times abstract, visual language to illustrate mental states and emotional processes, the film explores questions of identity, perception and human existence.

films.title: Mound
films.credit: Mound, Allison Schulnik, US 2011
films.synopsis: Grotesque figures made of clay, fabric and feathers disintegrate, merge and constantly reform – without ever becoming solid. Set to Scott Walker’s “It’s Raining Today”, an atmosphere of melancholy, beauty and controlled chaos unfolds. An experimental work of animation with a strong emphasis on materiality in which the boundaries between figure, body and matter are blurred.

films.title: This Is a Story Without a Plan
films.credit: This Is a Story Without a Plan, Cassie Shao, US 2023
films.synopsis: In fragmentary moments, two figures repeatedly witness a recurring explosion – threatening, yet strangely calm. Observations and impressions give rise to a meditative piece about transience, recollection and the silent presence of destruction.

prg3586.title: Kunstraum Baden: Animation Artefacts #2
prg3586.synopsis: For the second time, we are presenting sketches, figures and other objects from the filmmakers participating in the competition programmes. The exhibited works at Kunstraum Baden will change daily – a unique opportunity to look behind the scenes of animated film productions!

prg3575.title: Kinder-Walk-in-Workshop: Calling Planet Earth
prg3575.synopsis: Do you want to create your own animated film? With the stop motion technique and colourful playdough you can make the importance of our planet for humanity and nature visible. Come along and let's be creative together. Whether you have previous experience or not. Everyone is welcome.

prg3414.title: Mu-Yi, la légende du village des femmes
prg3414.synopsis: Mu-Yi lives in a remote village inhabited only by women. As she uncovers the secrets of her community, everything she believes is challenged. Torn between tradition, freedom and self-determination, she sets out to find her own path.

films.title: The Cloud Herder
films.credit: The Cloud Herder, Aidan McAteer, IE 2025
films.synopsis: An oldshepherdesslives high on a mountain and tends a flock of cloud sheep. To save the thirsty nature in the valley, she unleashes a storm ... but the rain clouds suddenly turn into a pack of wolves and threaten the sheep! Will the shepherdess manage to protect her flock?

films.title: Time
films.credit: TIME, Robert Löbel, Max Mörtl, DE 2025
films.synopsis: In a colourful and slightly chaotic world, little beings chase after time. Between an hourglass that never seems to run out and days that fly by far too quickly, each creature lives at its very own pace. Is it ever possible to catch up with lost time?

films.title: X0X0
films.credit: X0X0, Sarah Binz, CH 2025
films.synopsis: In the city of Bern, strange little creatures suddenly appear, dancing and playing to the rhythm of the music. Drawn directly onto the film reel, this experimental film transforms the urban backdrop into a playground full of movement, sounds and surprises.

films.title: Eeny, Meeny, Miny, Moe!
films.credit: Eeny, Meeny, Miny, Moe!, Andrea Szelesová, SK 2025
films.synopsis: Yios wishes for nothing more than to find friends but his head shines so brightly that the other children make fun of him. Because of a mean prank, he falls down to Earth. A magical story about diversity, the courage to be yourself and the power of friendship!

films.title: Taut
films.credit: Taut, Ilya Barrett, DE 2025
films.synopsis: Stringo just doesn’t quite fit in: unlike the others, he can hardly keep still. When a strange creature carries him off into the distance one day, a journey begins that changes him completely. Will he find his place again?

films.title: Fin People
films.credit: Fin People, Veronika Hozjan, HR/SI 2025
films.synopsis: When the city is flooded, people suddenly grow fins. Only an old shoemaker resists this change and nostalgically follows the traces of his former life. His wife, fascinated by the new freedom of the others, hesitates: should she go with the flow or follow a path of her own?

films.title: A Bird in the Head
films.credit: A Bird in the Head, Léonard Felder, CH 2026
films.synopsis: In a world where every person is born with a bird that embodies their inner potential, aman and his feathered companion drift further and further apart. Will they find their way back to each other? A whimsical fairy tale about the search for oneself.

films.title: The Dairy Experiment
films.credit: The Dairy Experiment, Fabian Johnston, Luke Johnston, US 2025
films.synopsis: A rather clumsy but very brave cow does everything she can to rescue her friend who has been abducted by aliens. Between prickly cacti and exploding cars, absolutely nothing goes according to plan!

films.title: Bookwyrms
films.credit: Bookwyrms, Mona Joana Gassner, Jessica Eugster, Cheyenne Klossner, Benjamin Gilli, CH 2025
films.director: Mona Joana Gassner, Jessica Eugster, Cheyenne Klossner, Benjamin Gilli
films.synopsis: A young writer is carried off into the wonderful world of books by her idea that has come to life. Amid adventures, discoveries and doubts, she learns that creating is not always easy ... and that sometimes you simply have to let go.

films.title: Little Boarlet
films.credit: Little Boarlet, Atsushi Wada, JP 2026
films.synopsis: A short story about a baby wild boar and his desire to dance and have fun.

films.title: Daughters of the Late Colonel
films.credit: Daughters of the Late Colonel, Elizabeth Hobbs, DE 2026
films.synopsis: After the death of their ill-tempered and controlling father, two middle-aged sisters find themselves at a loss. An unexpected visitor sparks the courage in them to begin their lives anew. An adaptation of a short story by the same name written by Katherine Mansfield in 1920.

films.title: West Wind
films.credit: West Wind, Sujin Min, KR 2026
films.synopsis: This world moves in repetitions, like waves that endlessly come and go. Within it, a woman walks. She passes through stages of her life. A wind blows in from the west, she turns to face a quiet sunset, together with the sun she fades beyond the horizon.

films.title: A Trip to the Ear
films.credit: A Trip to the Ear, Jee-youn Park, KR 2026
films.synopsis: A woman living in a house that drifts like cosmic debris wakes to find her right ear and her husband gone. To recover what was lost, she embarks on a surreal journey through the void.

films.title: Babyface
films.credit: Babyface, Sacha Beeley, UK 2026
films.synopsis: Spoon finds a coupon for a paradise.

films.title: Sexability
films.credit: Sexability, Anne-Christin Plate, DE 2026
films.synopsis: Disabled people who desire, who know the facts of life, who feel comfortable in their own skin, who experiment, who have sex – hard to imagine? “Sexability” shows the perception of sensuality and lust from the perspective of people with so-called intellectual disabilities.

films.title: Qui a tué Narin G**** ?
films.credit: Who Killed Narin G**** ?, Ayce Kartal, FR 2025
films.synopsis: She was eight when she went missing. The investigation revealed her family’s involvement. Narin saw something she should not have seen. Everyone in the village knew, but no one dared to speak out.

films.title: Dieu est timide
films.credit: God Is Shy, Jocelyn Charles, FR 2025
films.synopsis: During a train ride, Ariel and Paul pass the time sketching their deepest fears. Their game takes an unexpected turn when Gilda, a mysterious passenger, intrudes on their exchange. Yet her relationship with fear seems far less innocent than their playful drawings.

prg3413.title: Miss Moxy
prg3413.synopsis: Moxy is a terribly spoiled house cat. Suddenly left to her own devices, she has no choice but to team up with a well-trained dog and an ageing swallow. With a knack for local details, this Dutch- Belgian children’s film tells a story of empowerment, friendship and respect.

prg3561.title: Bagno Popolare
prg3561.synopsis: Bagno Popolare invites you once again to its short film programmes in Baden’s thermal bathing quarters. Take a seat at the edge of the pool, put on your water wings and join us on a journey through animated worlds.

prg3405.title: Bouchra
prg3405.synopsis: As the Moroccan director Bouchra chronicles her personal exploration of queer identity on film, the narrative layers become increasingly blurred. For this autobiographically inspired piece of metafiction, Meriem Bennani and Orian Yani Barki combine minimally animated animal figures with real-life backgrounds.

films.title: Pigeons
films.credit: Pigeons, Amos Sussigan, CH/US 2026
films.synopsis: The landline telephone network has been installed and all carrier pigeons are dismissed. This presents the birds with major challenges, such as finding food, shelter and meaning in life. An exploration of freedom and progress – and of what is lost in between.

films.title: Symbionts
films.credit: Symbionts, Quirijn Dees, CH 2025
films.synopsis: One form liquefies into a puddle, another reproduces itself in a living entanglement, while a third twitches under the attack of a parasitic being. In an unknown ecosystem, elegance and relentless violence emerge in symbiotic relationships between unique life forms.

films.title: Lost Touch
films.credit: Lost Touch, Justine Klaiber, CH 2025
films.synopsis: In the vastness of space, a survivor on a damaged spaceship struggles with grief and isolation. When a mysterious presence appears in the ship’s garden, she must make a momentous decision.

films.title: Vilain Jardin
films.credit: Growing Sprouts, Béatrice Herzig, CH 2026
films.synopsis: Capucine’s physical pain becomes increasingly unbearable. Eventually, she consults a doctor. The diagnosis: a goblin has taken up residence in her body and planted weeds everywhere.

films.title: The Rootman
films.credit: The Rootman, Yannick Barel, Benjamin Maurer, Alizée Gerber, CH2026
films.director: Yannick Barel, Benjamin Maurer, Alizée Gerber
films.synopsis: In the twilight of an autumn forest, Lilly searches for her older sister Nora. Guided by the lantern of the mysterious Rootman, she encounters secretive and eerie forest creatures. Will Lilly find her sister?

films.title: Cold Bathroom
films.credit: Cold Bathroom, Eleni Aerts, CH/BE 2025
films.synopsis: A woman has a frog inside her body. She tries to keep it there but the frog keeps demanding more space.

films.title: The Taste of Pineapple Bread
films.credit: The Taste of Pineapple Bread, Manfei Li, CH 2026
films.synopsis: A woman living in Switzerland wanders through a virtual map of the streets of her childhood in Hong Kong, following the traces of her late grandfather. As she becomes increasingly lost in this digital world, she searches for memories of him – longing to feel the warmth of their bond once more.

films.title: Bedrooms Make No Sense
films.credit: Bedrooms make no sense, Franziska Meyer, CH 2026
films.synopsis: When the bedroom travels with you, the extraordinary becomes commonplace. On the Côte d’Azur, the sea breeze blows in your face; in the Alps, dinner is cooking at sunset. An animated account of life in a bus.

films.title: To Kill a Velofahrer
films.credit: To Kill a Velofahrer, Helmi Korhonen, Ines Nungaesser, Livio Frauendor, Marvin Bueeler, CH 2026
films.director: Helmi Korhonen, Ines Nungässer, Livio Frauendorf, Marvin Büeler
films.synopsis: A proud urban planner defends his “visionary” cycle lane designs to his superiors. On the streets outside the conference room, his “perfect” plans plunge the city into chaos.

prg3402.title: All You Need Is Kill
prg3402.synopsis: During an alien invasion, Rita finds herself trapped in a time loop that feels like a computer game. In stark contrast to the live-action film starring Tom Cruise, the anime version of “All You Need Is Kill” focuses on the female protagonist and captivates audiences with its expressive aesthetics and bold colours.

films.title: Nonna Lucia
films.credit: Nonna Lucia, Marcel Barelli, CH 2026
films.synopsis: My grandmother Lucia died and left behind many objects. Many, many objects.

films.title: Pajarito
films.credit: Pajarito, Pilar Garcia-Fernandezsesma, ES/US 2026
films.synopsis: In 1980s Spain, two sisters confront their complicated feelings about motherhood when the eldest gives birth to her first child.

films.title: Mother of Dawn
films.credit: Mother of Dawn, Clara Trevisan, BR 2025
films.synopsis: In the void of night, a hungry creature looks for food and perpetuates an everyday cycle.

films.title: Papertowel Maxipad
films.credit: Papertowel Maxipad, Madeline Babuka Black, US 2026
films.synopsis: In this animated horror-meets-farce comedy, Claire wakes up in a compromising position. Will she be able to survive without bruising her ego?

films.title: Like a Fairy Tale
films.credit: Like A Fairy Tale, Kirill Khachaturov, FR/LU 2025
films.synopsis: After missing her father’s funeral, Stasya returns to her hometown after a long absence and is confronted by her elder sister. While sorting out her family’s issues, Stasya meets a series of local strangers who take her on a strange nocturnal trip.

films.title: Tiɣrist: Threads of Exile
films.credit: Tighrist - Threads of Exile, Samia Dzaïr, DZ/SA 2025
films.synopsis: Drawing inspiration from traditional weaving techniques, oral storytelling and contemporary modes of production, “Tiɣrist: Threads of Exile” invites reflection on textile as a language of resistance and a vessel of memory – a sensitive archive.

films.title: Superlover
films.credit: Superlover, Kushagra Kishore, Nivea Choudhary, Ryan Hmar, IN 2025
films.director: Kushagra Kishore, Nivea Choudhary, Ryan Hmar
films.synopsis: A young man deals with love and loneliness, finding comfort in the online ASMR (Autonomous Sensory Meridian Response) roleplay community.

films.title: Please
films.credit: Please, Anna Mantzaris, CZ/FI/FR/NO/SW 2026
films.synopsis: A dark comedy about mankind’s desire to love and be loved. An animated short centred around neediness, intimacy and romance.

prg3563.title: F.A.Q. – Fantoche Animation Quiz
prg3563.synopsis: Whether it’s Homer Simpson or Herman H. Rott, Pixar or pixilation – your knowledge of animation will be put to the test in the big Fantoche Animation Quiz at the Royal. There are some great prizes up for grabs!

prg3406.title: Carmen, l'oiseau rebelle
prg3406.synopsis: In 1840 Seville, a street boy and a pickpocket try to save the charismatic Carmen from her foretold fate. Sébastien Laudenbach translates the plot of Bizet’s opera into a contemporary, visually stunning plea for solidarity and resistance.

prg3403.title: Blaise
prg3403.synopsis: When his parents air their own problems in front of the school psychologist, 16-year-old Blaise would rather vanish into the floor. Gradually, such laconic scenes build into a revealing satire on insecurity, miscommunication and botched rebellions.

prg3408.title: Forgotten Island
prg3408.synopsis: With offbeat characters, outlandish ideas and karaoke, DreamWorks transports us to the Philippines of the 1990s, where Jo and Raissa dream of life on a mythical island. But when they actually get there years later, their close girlhood friendship is put to the test.

prg3538.title: 6 Editions of ANIMATEX: Egyptian New Voices​
prg3538.synopsis: ANIMATEX has grown since 2020 to become a key platform for Egyptian animation. In this collection with some of the best films from the last six editions, independent artists, students and studios will share bold stories in diverse styles, proving that after 90 years Egyptian animation is alive, fresh and ready for the world.

films.title: Play the Game
films.credit: Play the Game, Sandra Moneer, Ahmad Thabit, EG 2020
films.synopsis: A light-hearted exploration of everyday situations through four popular childhood games in Egyptian culture that have stood the test of time.

films.title: Soda
films.credit: Soda, Amr Shaalan, EG 2021
films.synopsis: A young cup with a straw who does not know the consequences of his actions, until something happens that forces him to stop.

films.title: Danse macabre
films.credit: Danse Macabre, Yomna Mohammed Ismail, EG 2021
films.synopsis: Anxiety slowly invites one into a dance of death, yet the sinister dance partner can be exchanged for a friend.

films.title: The Air and the Worlds
films.credit: The Air and the Worlds, Rana Ashraf, EG 2021
films.synopsis: A contemplative journey of three parts that follows a mutepoet named “This Person”. A dreamy flow of lightly illustrated musings reflect his observations on familiarity, language, impermanence and the strangeness of everything.

films.title: 1.25 EGP!
films.credit: 1.25 EGP!, Fatema Refaay, EG 2022
films.synopsis: One man’s scramble through the hustle and bustle of Cairo’s chaotic streets. Will he make it on time?

films.title: Long Night
films.credit: Long Night, Ahmed Adel, EG 2023
films.synopsis: A personal experience about dealing with light sleep and living in places where people are constantly making noise – and how this affects one’s character, inner peace and need to get some rest for the next day.

films.title: Bahr
films.credit: Bahr, Belal Samra, EG 2023
films.synopsis: While grieving the loss of his wife, a father grapples with faith in an effort to reconnect with her; the journey is portrayed as death being a beginning rather than an end, a simple line separating two worlds.

films.title: Kenopsia
films.credit: Kenopsia, Mohamed Omar, EG 2023
films.synopsis: An old man drives back to the now abandoned city of Cairo in order to reach his old home that he remembers from childhood. Longing for his homeland, he takes us on a short journey through the decayed city of Cairo, which becomes the actual protagonist.

films.title: Corn
films.credit: Corn, Youssef Mahmoud Hanafi, EG 2023
films.synopsis: The journey of fear and struggle of “Kernel K-500” who rebels againstthe cruelty of apartheid and the condescending perception of his kind. Moments before his salvation, the unexpected occurs.

films.title: Loop
films.credit: Loop, Eslam Qotb, EG 2024
films.synopsis: A girl stressed out from life’s pressures uses drugs to escape reality and must face the consequences of her actions. But will she change?

films.title: Natah
films.credit: Natah, Islam Ahmad, EG 2024
films.synopsis: A man flees his destiny, leaves his love behind and confronts death – in something that feels like a dream.

films.title: The Station
films.credit: The Station, Ahmed Sameh, EG 2025
films.synopsis: A man full of yearning and hope is finally going to reunite with his wife and meet his daughter for the first time after a long service in the army.

films.title: The Vision
films.credit: The Vision, Taha El Bialy Hamed, EG 2026
films.synopsis: The story unfolds in a distant future, a time when machines have risen to claim dominion over the planet. A world drowned in darkness where artificial intelligence rules with an iron fist and humanity survives only in its shadow.

films.title: A Pint of Bitter.
films.credit: A Pint of Bitter, Conor Kehelly, IE 2025
films.synopsis: You are trying to enjoy a quiet pint in the pub but a patron and his son seem to have a problem with your demeanour.

films.title: Tell Me When You Get Home
films.credit: Tell Me When You Get Home, Tshay Meade, US 2026
films.synopsis: During a reggae house party, 15-year-old Honest Cardamom encounters the spirit of a lost loved one.

films.title: Fingerbang
films.credit: Fingerbang, Yeonwoo Kim, KR 2026
films.synopsis: Rejected by everyone, a woman follows a mysterious finger into a surreal realm, where a tender yet unsettling touch slowly begins to twist her reality.

films.title: Display Nature
films.credit: Display Nature, Nicolas Gebbe, DE 2026
films.synopsis: Blending CGI collages, photogrammetry and real footage, “Display Nature” explores how urban and digital spaces mirror our ideas of nature and ourselves. A reflection on perception, the absurdities of commodification and the disconnect within artificial modern life. “Shape nature to shape yourself.”

films.title: Scratch
films.credit: Scatch, Erwann Hette, FR 2025
films.synopsis: Somewhere between fiction and animated documentary, this film tells the story of autistic boy Sacha. We learn about his specific interests and the efforts made by his personal care assistant and his preschool teacher Nicolas, who demonstrate their commitment to supporting and guiding Sacha, despite the challenges they face every day.

films.title: Dynamo
films.credit: Dynamo, Tal Gadon, PT 2026
films.synopsis: Atop a misty, secluded hill, one extraordinary morning grants power to the people.

films.title: Cosmonauts
films.credit: Cosmonauts, Leo Cernic, IT/SI 2026
films.synopsis: On an intergalactic cruise for singles, lonely souls chase a kiss, a caress or just a glimpse of love among the stars.

prg3569.title: How to Tourist
prg3569.synopsis: During the holidays, we hop on a plane, a train, in a car or on a boat, in search of a sense of happiness. We rarely ask ourselves who actually has the privilege of being able to travel. This short film programme explores the joys, absurdities and contradictions of being on the move – a travel guide with dos and don’ts.

films.title: Vacances
films.credit: Vacances, Alice Dybowski, FRA 2025
films.synopsis: Maxence is eating the scabs off his knees. Octave is bored, Aude and Marika are playing cards, Victor is sick and Emi is looking out the window. At the back of the bus taking them to summer camp, eight children talk about their daily lives through stories personally experienced or heard by the author.

films.title: Percebes
films.credit: Percebes, Alexandra Ramires, Laura Gonçalves, PT 2024
films.synopsis: Against the backdrop of the sea and the urban Algarve coastline, we follow the complete lifecycle of a special shellfish called the Percebes or goose barnacle. From their formation to their consumption, we come across various contexts along this journey that allow us to better understand this region and those who live there.

films.title: Intermission Expedition
films.credit: Intermission Expedition, Wiep Teeuwisse, NL 2019_02
films.synopsis: During a sunny holiday, a group of tourists struggles to let go of their busy city lives. The absence of their daily tasks leaves them feeling lost at the beginning, but once they learn to slow down, beautiful things start happening.

films.title: The Illustrated Woman
films.credit: The Illustrated Woman, Isabel Herguera, ES 2023
films.synopsis: How to Dream: Ramia wishes to fly, Saadiya dreams of a women’s parliament, Shubhashree longs to travel to Switzerland and Samira claims her independence through rap.

films.title: Airport
films.credit: Airport, Michaela Müller, HR/CH 2017_01
films.synopsis: Airports bring modern society into focus. This is where organisational systems, frameworks and security measures can be seen and felt. In the transit zone, lifelines intersect or pass one another without contact. And while for some this is where their journey begins, for others this is where it comes to an abrupt end.

films.title: Two Ice Creams Please
films.credit: Two Ice Creams Please, Jasmine Elsen, BE 2026
films.synopsis: During their holiday, two young women get lost in a rainforest. After wandering around for days, their irritation with one another grows. While increasingly dreaming about ice cream, they become conscious of their own vulnerability.

films.title: Été 96
films.credit: ÉTÉ 96, Mathilde Bédouet, FR 2023
films.synopsis: Every year, Paul, his family and their friends attend the perpetual “August 15 picnic” on Callot Island. But this year, they find themselves trapped by the tide. Paul, upset, stuck between the world of adults and that of children, becomes aware of his individuality.

prg3407.title: Decorado
prg3407.synopsis: Arnold, an unemployed mouse, increasingly suspects his entire world is nothing more than a stage set. Based on his short film of the same name, Alberto Velázquez has created quirky, damaged characters who are plotting their escape from this controlling, capitalist-driven construct of reality.

prg3542.title: 105’600 Frames of Splitting
prg3542.synopsis: Plastic floats in the sea; entire regions have become and continue to become uninhabitable due to toxins and drought. We are living at the expense of future generations, who will experience friendships and first love while dealing with climate-induced storms and poisoned forests.

films.title: Orgiastic Hyper-Plastic
films.credit: Orgiastic Hyper-Plastic, Paul Bush, GB 2020
films.synopsis: An animated extravaganza of plastic collected from beaches, roadsides, attics and junk shops. This is an elegy to a love affair that has gone sour, a fond farewell to that most beautiful material that has enslaved our planet – plastic.

films.title: Freeze Frame
films.credit: Freeze Frame, Soetkin Verstegen, BE 2019
films.synopsis: Filmed purely in black and white, “Freezeframe” celebrates the act of thawing out images frozen in film – and in ice. The crackle of ice intertwines with mechanical noises made bythe film technology. It isn’t long before the strands of illusion and perception are woven together.

films.title: Pile
films.credit: Pile, Toby Auberg, UK 2019
films.synopsis: A CG animated short film that attempts to put human constructs in order. A vertical habitat that models material progression from bare survival to the unhinged dystopia of late capitalism.

films.title: The World's After
films.credit: El after del mundo, Florentina Gonzalez, AR/FR 2022
films.synopsis: Fluor and Carlix, two ghosts wearing sportswear wander through the remains of an extinct civilisation, looking for a Wi-Fi connection and the head of a giant whale. A story of encounter and friendship, to the rhythms of the ultimate playlist: the end of the world.

films.title: Peripheria
films.credit: Peripheria, David Coquard-Dassault, FR 2015
films.synopsis: The wind blows through abandoned satellite towns. In the harsh southern winter light, a pack of blackdogs scampers through farms. Loud barks sound in the empty spaces – they are an echo of the voices that were once heard when the area was populated.

films.title: La tête dans les orties
films.credit: La tête dans les orties, Paul E. Cabon, FR 2019
films.synopsis: Childhood friendships can be quite complicated, and things might turn out to be different from what they seemed. Bastien and his two friends enter the dense, forbidden forest area. In its abandoned ruins, concealed by a toxic haze, something unexpected is waiting to happen.

films.title: Once There Was a Sea...
films.credit: Once there Was a Sea..., Joanna Kozuch, SK/PL 2021
films.synopsis: Svetlana stares into the salt desert with her only eye. Sergei drives tourists across its bare, glittering seabed. Few people of Mo’ynoq remember the original shore of drying Aral Sea. Their days are intertwined with memories of the glorious past and dreams of the return of the great water.

prg3396.title: Panorama Festival Gems
prg3396.synopsis: The “Panorama Festival Gems” programme showcases some of our favourite films from the current festival season. They have been captivating audiences on major festival screens around the globe already for months, generating buzz, touching hearts, surprising viewers or leaving them smiling.The selection is comprised of films that celebrated their world premieres at renowned festivals such as the Krakow Film Festival, the International Film Festival Rotterdam, Annecy or the Berlinale. Others – such as “Hungry Hollow”, “The Sycamore” or “Abortion Party” – have long since established themselves as box-office favourites. Some films are a perfect fit for a competition. Others don’t lend themselves for a competition programme but are simply too good not to be shown! “Panorama Festival Gems” spotlights these cinematic discoveries that we couldn’t possibly keep from you, despite our packed competition programmes.

films.title: Tears
films.credit: Tears, Paulina Ziolkowska, PL 2025
films.synopsis: “Tears” tells the story of a woman caught between countless possibilities. Every decision opens up new paths and sees others disappear. In striking images, the film explores uncertainty, freedom and the overwhelming pressure of constant decision-making.

films.title: Hungry Hollow
films.credit: Hungry Hollow, Sarah Franny Ruyle, US 2025
films.synopsis: A group of forest spirits meet by the pond and gleefully go about their mischief.

films.title: Corpus Christi
films.credit: El Cuerpo del Cristo, Bea Lema, ES 2025
films.synopsis: Living with an unacknowledged mental disorder, Adela seeks answers in popular rituals. She feels that something is watching and harming her, and seems to only find understanding in religion. During a visit to a healer, she confesses the disturbing origin of her suffering.

films.title: The Sycamore
films.credit: The Sycamore, Jared D. Weiss, US 2025
films.synopsis: Two weary travellers seek out shade and sustenance from a tree. Based on Aesop’s fable, “The Travellers and the Plane Tree”.

films.title: 9 Million Colors
films.credit: 9 Million Colors, Bára Anna, DE/NO 2025
films.synopsis: The ocean is a paradise for shrimp Fran. With her deadly claws, she takes whatever she wants. For blind fish Milva, it’s a daily fight for survival. Fran finds her beautiful and wants her to see the ocean in the same way she does. Can these two overcome their differences?

films.title: Abortion Party
films.credit: Abortion Party, Julia Mellen, ES 2025
films.synopsis: Having scraped together enough money to pay for an abortion after her Polish exchange student boyfriend got her pregnant, the director decides to celebrate with a party. In attendance are her geriatric ska musician neighbour, semi-retired gang members, her grubby gay roommate and the ever-present bedbugs.

films.title: Autokar
films.credit: Autokar, Sylwia Szkiłądź, BE/FR 2025
films.synopsis: In the 1990s, eight-year-old Agata leaves Poland for Belgium. Her perspective transforms the reality of migration into an initiatory experience.

prg3559.title: Artists' Brunch
prg3559.synopsis: Brunch with Fantoche! Filmmakers from the short film programmes will give an insight into their thought processes and the creation of their films in a relaxed morning discussion over coffee and brunch.

prg3540.title: Key Frames: Animation in the Archive
prg3540.synopsis: In 2012, Cimatheque – Alternative Film Centre received the private collection of pioneering Egyptian animator Ihab Shaker. For over ten years, the archival team has dedicated itself to the thorough work of categorising, cleaning, repairing, scanning, indexing and preserving this monumental legacy. Today, a decade’s worth of archival labour is finally ready to be shared.

films.title: Un, deux, trois...
films.credit: Un, deux, trois..., Ihab Shaker, EG 1974
films.synopsis: In three short stories, a man discovers a shower, a bird and a machine. What could possibly go wrong?

films.title: Chansons d’animaux
films.credit: Chansons d’animaux, Ihab Shaker, EG 1987
films.synopsis: “Songs of Animals” is a series of short animated episodes that tell whimsical and humorous stories centred on different animals: “The Crocodile” and “The Crow”. Through simple yet intricate lines and visually stunning frames, the series showcases the brilliance of Ihab Shaker’s storytelling. Bringing traditional Egyptian cultural motifs to life in French, it creates a cross-cultural hybrid that was truly ahead of its time.

films.title: Love Dance
films.credit: Love Dance, Ihab Shaker, EG 1996
films.synopsis: In this award-winning animated short, filmmaker Ihab Shaker captures the unspoken language of attraction through the rhythmic movements of a horse and a mare. “Love Dance” explores the delicate space between instinct and emotion, using fluid visuals and an evocative original score by Georges Kazazian to reflect the complexities of a budding connection. At once playful and profound, the film creates its own internal rhythm, exploring the depth of what is felt but remains unsaid.

prg3417.title: The Last Blossom
prg3417.synopsis: Akutsu, a former yakuza, recounts his life story to a plant from his deathbed in prison. Baku Kinoshita unfolds a web of choices and questions of conscience that gives his idiosyncratically drawn characters unexpected depth.

prg3564.title: Find a Producer
prg3564.synopsis: This event offers animation filmmakers the chance to pitch their ideas and skills in one-on-one discussions with Swiss producers.

prg4323.title: Tattoos by Bianca Caderas
prg4323.synopsis: Get yourself a – weird, slightly trashy, but still classy – souvenir, one that you will have to last forever. There will be a selection of smaller, eye-catching designs that are perfect for easy placement on arms or legs. See you at the tattoo booth!

prg3416.title: Son of a Bitch
prg3416.synopsis: In search of his father, Ismael, the son of a prostitute, crosses Brazil’s arid hinterland on foot with his three-legged dog. With stubborn characters, coarse language and a woodcutlike aesthetic, this offbeat road movie stands refreshingly apart from mainstream animation.
prg3416.director: Erica Maradona, Otto Guerra, Sávio Leite, Tania Anaya

prg3404.title: Allah n'est pas obligé
prg3404.synopsis: Whilst searching for his aunt, ten-year-old Birahima becomes embroiled as a child soldier in the civil wars of Liberia and Sierra Leone. A film adaptation told with unsentimental empathy and a keen sense of the power of words.

prg3535.title: Meet the Aard(wo)man: Sarah Cox
prg3535.synopsis: Chief Creative Director Sarah Cox sheds light on her involvement with the studio’s creative and production processes, discussing recent productions and focusing on female creativity. As an Aard(wo)man, she plays a key role in the development and direction of the successful creative output of Aardman Studios. Aardman became one of the first successful European alternatives to the American animation industry, with its distinctly British approach to stop-motion animation. The studio is celebrating its 50th anniversary and remains a key figure in high-quality, award-winning commercial and auteur work in both short and long formats. With clips from recent award-winning works – and maybe a few sneak peeks.

prg3528.title: Animation x Game Design
prg3528.synopsis: In this workshop, students of animation (HSLU) and game design (ZHdK) will come together to collectively develop games or gaming experiences. They will explore how both disciplines overlap and experiment with ways in which to collaborate during this brief but intensive exchange. The guided tour offers a behind-the-scenes look at the creative process ahead of the final presentation on Saturday as part of Game Pop-up #3.

prg3541.title: Let's Talk: Animated Films on the Egyptian Scene
prg3541.synopsis: “Let’s Talk” invites you to discover the Egyptian animation scene – a space for exploring the interplay between a longstanding media history, popular childhood imagery, cultural memory and new creative voices.

prg3560.title: Artists’ Coffee & Cake
prg3560.synopsis: As a counterpart to our Artists’ Brunch, we are launching the new Artists’ Coffee & Cake series, in which our feature-film guests have their say and a chance to talk about their films. Fantoche invites you to join us for this round of talks over fresh coffee, tea and cake.

prg3418.title: We Are Aliens
prg3418.synopsis: Though shy, Tsubasa is equally fascinated and annoyed by his eccentric classmate Gyotaro. With shifting perspectives and subtle portrayal of characters, this featurefilm debut paints a complex picture of friends drifting apart that goes well beyond the boundaries of a classic coming-of-age story.

prg3398.title: Panorama Next Gen
prg3398.synopsis: In the “Panorama Next Gen” programme, stories packed with adventure, courage and surprising encounters await you. A left-handed snail sets out in search of true love (“T L’escargot gaucher”), a mysterious button on a bus causes chaos (“Service Bus”), and a young woman returns to her homeland in search of answers to unresolved questions (“Como si la tierra se las hubiera tragado”).The films deal with themes of friendship, family, identity and the desire to seek one’s own destiny. We discover social changes (“Yvan’s revelation”), follow a transgender teenager on her journey of self-discovery (“Eyeliner”) and discover other stories from ever-changing perspectives. At times humorous, sometimes thought-provoking and occasionally wonderfully whimsical, the films show that the most fascinating stories often begin just around the next corner.

films.title: L’escargot gaucher
films.credit: The Left-Handed Snail, Matteo Boulard, Clément Nahmias, Louis Velaine, Valentin Decombes, Gabryël Aury, Mathys Mysius , FR 2025
films.director: Matteo Boulard, Clément Nahmias, Louis Velaine, Valentin Decombes, Gabryël Aury, Mathys Mysius
films.synopsis: A left-handed snail, unable to reproduce with right-handed snails, sets off on a long journey to find love. An animal documentary that truly touches the heart.

films.title: Service Bus
films.credit: Service Bus, Elmer Mikael Lødemel, DK 2025
films.synopsis: We all know the service button on planes – but what about the ones on buses? When a bored traveler stumbles upon one, his curiosity gets the better of him. But with only the bus driver on duty, pressing it might lead to unexpected consequences.

films.title: As if Swallowed by Earth
films.credit: Como si la tierra se las hubiera tragado, Natalia León, FR 2025
films.synopsis: Olivia, a young woman living abroad, returns to her hometown in Mexico in the hope of reconnecting with her past but also understanding the history of violence against women in Mexico.

films.title: Sweet Joy
films.credit: Sweet Joy, Bianca Caderas, CH 2025
films.synopsis: In a surreal dream world, bizarre creatures and mysterious machines encounter one another. Between closeness and distance, a poetic journey unfolds, full of magic, lightness and quiet melancholy.

films.title: The Power's Out
films.credit: The Power's Out, Laurie Cruz Arocho, PR/US 2025
films.synopsis: Two sisters indulge in a game of cards while they wait for the power to come back on. A glimpse into everyday life in Puerto Rico.

films.title: Petra and the Sun
films.credit: Petra and the Sun, Malu Furche, Stefania Malacchini, CL 2025
films.synopsis: During a heavy snowmelt in the Andes, Petra, 71, discovers the perfectly preserved corpse of a mountaineer from the last century. Initially hesitant, she brings him to her wooden chalet, sparking an unexpected romantic story.

films.title: La révélation d’Yvan
films.credit: Yvan’s Revelation, Morgan Curt, FR 2025
films.synopsis: Following a shocking discovery, Yvan lives through a night of horror.

films.title: L’amour vache
films.credit: There’s Something in the Milk, Cliona Noonan, FR 2025
films.synopsis: On a small farm somewhere in Ireland, Oona spends her days milking cows with her mother, who seems to think more about her cows and their milk than about her own daughter.

films.title: The Wolf Has Come
films.credit: The Wolf Has Come, Brian Christopher Hawkins, NO 2026
films.synopsis: A short animated film about the tense relationship between humans and the wolf.

films.title: Eyeliner
films.credit: Eyeliner, Aisha Boudjillouli, GB 2026
films.synopsis: Nina and her best friend Lily decide to steal an eyeliner, hoping they have finally found their key to womanhood. When they are met with wildly different reactions to wearing it, Nina discovers that her journey as a trans girl might not be so easy.

prg3556.title: Allegro non troppo
prg3556.synopsis: As Italy’s answer to Disney’s “Fantasia”, six animated short films have been set to classical music. Bruno Bozzetto’s magnum opus, which celebrates its 50th anniversary this year, is brimming with delightful humour, creative ideas and satirical digs at modern consumer society.

prg3409.title: Jim Queen
prg3409.synopsis: After a mysterious viral infection, influencer Jim Parfait appears to be turning heterosexual. Nicolas Athane and Marco Nguyen mix body culture, football, driving beats and social anxieties in a light-footed comedy about gay cis men’s sense of self.

prg3585.title: Peer2Beer – Animation Meets Illustration
prg3585.synopsis: Meet other professional illustrators and animators while networking in a friendly team game – without the pressure of being in the spotlight. Loads of fun, skilland cool prizes!

prg3410.title: Junk World
prg3410.synopsis: In a dystopian world, robots and humans must jointly investigate an anomaly in the space-time continuum. For this sprawling prequel to “Junk Head”, Takahide Hori and a tiny team have created a stop-motion grotesque film full of time loops, absurd ideas and eccentric figures.

prg3415.title: Nobody
prg3415.synopsis: A clumsy pig-like demon and three other outsider animal beings pose as the heroes of the legendary Journey to the West in a bid for immortality. In China, this endearing buddy movie about deception and loyalty became the most successful Chinese animated film.

prg3411.title: Le mystère Lucy Lost
prg3411.synopsis: Why does eleven-year-old Lucy have white hair? Why can’t anyone else see her friend of the same age? And what do the villagers have against her? While closely linked to the First World War, Lucy’s search for a sense of belonging unfolds with an emotional force unrelated to the historical context.

prg3582.title: Waldbaden & Luftschnappen
prg3582.synopsis: The shade of the trees invites you to enjoy some forest bathing. Escape the stresses of everyday life and, with an eye for the finer things, learn once again to breathe deeply, listen and ground yourself. Slip on your swimwear and immerse yourself in this thematically curated programme.

films.title: Une fugue
films.credit: Une Fugue, Agnès Patron, FR 2025
films.synopsis: The Sister remembers that her Brother had dark eyes, hair like her own, shoulders as fragile as a bird’s wings, and that he knew the way to the river by heart. The Sister has forgotten nothing about her Brother.

films.title: Strangers With Hats
films.credit: Strangers With Hats, Petra Stipetic, Karo Twiddy, DE 2026
films.synopsis: Noe, a tiny mushroom spore, packs her bags and sets off on a magical journey of self-discovery. Together with other mushrooms and a handful of self-doubt, she gets to know the strengths and weaknesses of her spore network.

films.title: La mort du poisson
films.credit: The Death of the Fish, Eva Lusbaronian, FR 2025
films.synopsis: What begins with a dead fish turns, for a young girl, into a desperate struggle for the memories of her unhappy mother. She confronts her own powerlessness through the only means of expression left to her: dance.

films.title: Le jour où j’ai léché un caillou
films.credit: The Day I Licked a Pebble, Flavie Eliézer, Chloé Bernuchon, Goli Atefi, Maud Kolasa, Nathan Jauze, Marie Pijollet, FR 2025
films.director: Flavie Eliézer, Chloé Bernuchon, Goli Atefi, Maud Kolasa, Nathan Jauze, Marie Pijollet
films.synopsis: In search of a bakery, three young siblings set off forthe village. But to get there they must cross an eerie forest, where scary stories threaten to become reality.

films.title: Utsukushiki Tennen
films.credit: Utsukushiki Tennen, Romane Granger, FR 2017
films.synopsis: Blooming, fading, transformation: In a continuous cycle, colourful modelling clay flows rhythmically into itself, constantly giving rise to new forms.

films.title: Wings for Butterflies
films.credit: Wings for Butterflies, Tilly Wallace, US 2022
films.synopsis: Man-made disaster threatens to destroy California’s redwood forests. But the forest dwellers, among them a tree spirit, do everything they can to avert this fate and save their ecosystem.

films.title: Lunar Love & Ever
films.credit: Lunar Love & Ever, Gabriel Gabriel Garble, SE 2021
films.synopsis: A full moon keeps everyone awake, especially one moon-obsessed ladybird. Will it ever reach the moon?

films.title: Stranding
films.credit: Stranding, Ben Kadie, US 2023
films.synopsis: Theo’s parents are getting divorced. His only friend and source of comfort is a stranded whale.

films.title: Sum of Its Parts
films.credit: Sum of its Parts, Alisa Stern, US 2021
films.synopsis: Attracted by music, the small woodland creatures transform their magical forest into a dance floor.

films.title: Dahlia
films.credit: Dahlia, Ana Mouyis, CY 2017
films.synopsis: Two lovers embark on a journey through acolourful, constantly transforming world. But something unstoppable lurks amidst the hand-painted colours, disturbing their idyll.

prg3579.title: Music Video Darlings Vol. 11
prg3579.synopsis: More music, more animation, more darlings! With this year’s music videos, we’re bringing together the “Music Video Darlings” and “Trash Music Videos”, which were previously screened separately, in a single eclectic programme. Sit back and let the sounds and images transport you to a place where crazy and fantasy merge.

prg3557.title: Angel’s Egg – Restored Version
prg3557.synopsis: A white-haired girl, an egg and a young wanderer. That was all Mamoru Oshii and the illustrator Yoshitaka Amano needed, ten years before “Ghost in the Shell”, to create a visually stunning, intensely atmospheric science-fiction meditation that leaves room for individual interpretation.

prg3570.title: Industry Breakfast
prg3570.synopsis: Our annual Industry Breakfast allows for a relaxed start to an inspiring and socially engaging day, providing an opportunity for informal exchange over coffee and croissants.

prg3571.title: Industry Day: Hope is a Word with 24 fps
prg3571.synopsis: The theme is intended as a way to offset these uncertain times: wars, the economy, artificial intelligence – there is currently plenty to threaten artistic expression, and yet we can (and must) produce works that foster empathy and solidarity through creativity, artistry and humour.

prg3566.title: Focus: Beyond the Screen
prg3566.synopsis: A discussion on how the medium of animation is conceived outside the confines of the classic cinema format, and how alternative approaches to screening, promotion and contextualisation can be utilised.

prg3573.title: Focus: Falling Apart is Not an Option
prg3573.synopsis: A discussion on resilience, humour and the determination to create astonishing and artistically outstanding works despite all the odds.

prg3547.title: Pom Poko
prg3547.synopsis: A forest near Tokyo is set to be cleared for a new housing development, much to the dismay of the tanuki (raccoon dogs) who live there. So they band together to stand against the humans. A touching and delightfully amusing eco-fable, directed by master filmmaker and co-founder of Studio Ghibli Isao Takahata.

prg3592.title: Portfolio Review and Recruiting Session
prg3592.synopsis: Representatives from various studios and freelancers will provide feedback on portfolios and share information about possible job vacancies in brief speed-dating sessions.

prg3537.title: Retrospective: Isabelle Favez
prg3537.synopsis: Isabelle Favez, a Bern-born director, screenwriter, animator, cinematographer, character designer and editor, has mastered the A to Z of animation. Often consciously navigating between child and adult perspectives, she combines naivety with unexpected, darker elements. From Bern to Zurich, Valence to Montréal, her internationally acclaimed co-productions for audiences young and old have taken her across the globe. Her films travel with her – and beyond. This retrospective is interwoven with the director’s reflections on animation and the freedom the medium offers her, as well as on inspiration, ambitions, craftsmanship and plans for a feature film.

films.title: Lost Brain
films.credit: Lost Brain, Isabelle Favez, CH 2021
films.synopsis: One day, Louise the crocodile accidentally sneezes her brain out. To top it all off, it even escapes! This suddenly makes it difficult for Louise to perform the simplest tasks: nothing seems to work anymore.

films.title: Replay

films.title: Circuit Marine

films.title: Au cœur de l'hiver
films.credit: Au cœur de l'hiver, Isabelle Favez, CH 2012
films.synopsis: In “Au coeur de l’hiver” (In the heart of the winter), we observe how five forest dwellers, with varying degrees of success, prudence and craftiness, augment their food supplies in order to survive the winter. Isabelle Favez has turned this struggle into a simple, bitter-sweet tale that will touch children and adults alike.

films.title: Valise
films.credit: Valise, Isabelle Favez, CH 2009
films.synopsis: A suitcase full of money not only revitalises an unhappy relationship but also causes havoc and tension between three bank robbers. «Valise» is a film about greed, cheap suitcases and a fortunate dog.

films.title: Messages dans l'air
films.credit: Air Mail, Isabelle Favez, CH/FR 2015
films.synopsis: A fish, a cat, a woman and a big strong boxer are the ingredients of this little tale that has the tough little fish’s health to thank for its happy ending. Indeed, the fish is so robust that it is totally unperturbed by its journey through the cat’s digestive tract.
