films.credit: Tarte aux pommes, Isabelle Favez, CH 2006
films.synopsis: A baker falls in love with the butcher, but the hunter’s dog muddles her plans.

prg3558.title: Artist Talk: Joanna Quinn
prg3558.synopsis: The internationally acclaimed British director is one of the most prominent contemporary voices in animation. She will be speaking about her career, the importance of humour and her future projects.

prg3545.title: Let's Talk: Rethinking Nature, Narrative and Responsibility
prg3545.synopsis: We will explore the question of how nature can – or should – be depicted in art, especially in animated film. Guests from various fields will examine this question from aesthetic, narrative and ethical perspectives. The discussion will feature brief keynote presentations, followed by in-depth discussion.

prg3581.title: SAIA - Swiss Animation Industry Award #9
prg3581.synopsis: In cooperation with the Swissfilm Association, the shortlist of the best animated films in Switzerland will be presented and a winning film selected. To kick things off, a case study will be presented as part of “What’s up Switzerland?”

prg3534.title: Making-of: «Dandelion's Odyssey»
prg3534.synopsis: “Dandelion’s Odyssey”, Momoko Seto’s multi-award-winning first feature film, has received the highest praise during its tour of the festivals worldwide. In a breathtaking, magical blend of 3D animation, macro live action and time-lapse cinematography, it tells the dazzling and poetic odyssey of four dandelion acheneswhich, having survived a series of nuclear explosions that destroyed Earth, are hurled into the cosmos. With great artistic craftsmanship, the film opens up a new perspective on the beauty of the nature that surrounds us. Dive deep into the creation process behind the breathtaking beauty of the film’s fauna, flora and climate — all of which pose challenges the protagonists must overcome.

prg3543.title: Dandelion's Odyssey
prg3543.synopsis: When a nuclear explosion destroys the Earth, four dandelion seeds are catapulted into space. Thus begins their perilous search for a place where they can take root. Time-lapse photography is used as a stylistic device to symbolise the loss of the very foundations of our existence: we are running out of time. A film not just for adults, but for the whole family.

prg3572.title: Karaoke
prg3572.synopsis: Sing your song, dance your dance! After a long day at the festival, there’s only one thing better than sleep, and what’s more, it’sa real energy boost: karaoke. We guarantee highly motivated and virtuoso background singers, keen to celebrate the thrill of singing out of tune together. Curtains up!

prg3590.title: Midnight Snack: The Video Synthesizer. Exploring a Lost History of Electronic Animation
prg3590.synopsis: The video synthesizer creates and manipulates video images and has gone through many phases since its invention in the 1950s. Through films, talks and a performance, we dive into a little-known chapter of moving-image history and explore it as a tool for visual experimentation.

films.title: Abstronic
films.credit: Abstronic, Mary Ellen Bute, USA 1952, © Center for Visual Music
films.synopsis: From the mind of one of the 20th century’s most innovativeabstract filmmakers, “Abstronic” combines abstraction and electronics to produce a playful flow of images reminiscent of an abstract painting in motion. Bute, who was also a painter, created the film using electronic images which were produced by a specially designed oscilloscope and combined with traditional animation.

films.title: The Dynne
films.credit: The Dynne, Lee Harrison III, US 1968

films.title: Astroman
films.credit: Astroman, Lee Harrison III, US 1968

films.title: Mr. Computer Image
films.credit: Mr. Computer Image, Lee Harrison III, USA 1968

films.title: Turn on Dancer
films.credit: Turn on Dancer, Lee Harrison III, USA 1969
films.synopsis: These films show the capabilities of the Animac analogue computer, predecessor to the Scanimate videosynthesiser which would later kickstart a new era in motion graphics during the 1970s. The Animac’ssweeping and fluid forms, created using manually controlled cathode rays which drew on screen in real time, give an early example of electronically designed and animated characters.

films.title: Cycles
films.credit: Cycles, Stephen Beck, Jordan Belson, USA 1974, © 1974 by Stephen Beck. All Rights Reserved. stevebeck.tv. Courtesy of Electronic Arts Intermix (EAI), New York.
films.synopsis: A union between two artists and their two mediums of expression: celluloid film and electronic video. Beck, the young inventor of his own video synthesiser, and Belson, a famed abstract filmmaker and animation artist twice his age, spent two years working together on this journey through spheres of thought, mysticism and form. Deeply psychedelic and yet with all the weightlessness of light.

films.title: Heartbeat
films.credit: Heartbeat, Bill Etra, Luise Etra, USA 1973
films.synopsis: An experiment to “explore the control of video images through physiological signals”. This short was made using Bill’s Rutt/Etra video synthesiser, connected to a biomedical heart monitor which tracked Louise’s heartrate. A representation of Louise’s heart is created on screen using the synthesiser and modulated in real time, following her heartbeat as the film unfolds.

films.title: Mona Lisa
films.credit: Mona Lisa, Toshio Matsumoto, JP 1973
films.synopsis: Japanese artist Toshio Matsumoto uses the Scanimate video synthesiser to take the Mona Lisa on a surreal journey through landscapes that are both real and artificial. In doing so, he projects a kind of fantasy world of electronic images, exploding colours and movement onto his subject, animating her as a shimmering psychedelic vision and accompanied by her own abstract electronic soundtrack.

films.title: Drug Abuse
films.credit: Drug Abuse, Pat Lehman, US 1972
films.synopsis: Originally intended as an anti-drug public service announcement for local television, this short, 60-second film instead takes us on a trippy ride through Day-Glo colours and Pop-Art visuals, all melting into each other with the help of the Scanimate video synthesiser. Although one of her earliest films, it was also one of Lehman’s most successful, going on to be shown at the Cannes Film Festival.

films.title: Five-Minute Romp Through the IP
films.credit: Five-Minute Romp Through the IP, Dan Sandin, US 1973
films.synopsis: Video artist and physics graduate Dan Sandin takes the viewer on a short tour of the Sandin Image Processor (IP), a modular video synthesiser that he invented himself. What starts as a serious technical introduction to the synthesiser slowly spaces out into a visual experiment with colour and effects as Dan, wearing what appears to be a Catholic cardinal’s hat, tries to remain focused.

films.title: Electronic Masks
films.credit: Electronic Masks, Barbara Sykes, US 1978
films.synopsis: Sykes, a master craftswoman of electronic visuals, manages to wrangle the abstract into the familiar. Bending and warping the raw colours and shapes of the Sandin Image Processor, she creates a series of images that seem to emanate from some ancient subconscious. Mixed together tightly with a percussive soundtrack, the film is a vibrant experiment in visual music.

films.title: Vocabulary
films.credit: Vocabulary, Woody Vasulka, US 1973
films.synopsis: A study on texture, amorphous forms and the body via image processing and video synthesis. Beginning as a simple exercise in contrast and keying effects, the electronic eye of the video camera begins to hallucinate more and more as it tracks the artist through a series of oblique experiments, before finally breaking down completely, recreating reality as a vibrating electronic mesh.

films.title: Aquarelles
films.credit: Aquarelles, Vibeke Sorensen, Tom DeWitt, Dean Winkler, US 1980
films.director: Vibeke Sorensen, Tom DeWitt, Dean Winkler
films.synopsis: DeWitt, Sorensen and Winkler were a dream team of artist-engineers; a talented group whose fluency in new media and technology would go on to win them numerous awards and accolades. Their skills in videosynthesis and processing are clearly visible in this dreamy, psychedelic drift through synthesised new age landscapes made of vapourwave colours and swirling, fractal-like shapes.

films.title: Sun Ra's Calling Planet Earth With the OVC
films.credit: Sun Ra's Calling Planet Earth with the OVC, Bill Sebastian, US 1986
films.synopsis: Bill Sebastian’s Outer Space Visual Communicator (OVC) was constructed from lights, mirrors, projectors and video effect and mixing equipment, and could be played like a live instrument with hands, feet and even the mouth! Here we get a glimpse of the OVC’s kaleidoscopic visual effects, which were used by the Sun Ra Arkestra to “visualize soundwaves” as part of their touring cosmic stage show.

prg3525.title: Playful Animation Talk: «Ground of Aces» – Animating an Indie Game
prg3525.synopsis: Eating, drinking, sleeping, talking, getting carried around dead … The characters in “Ground of Aces” have their hands full whilst fighting the Nazis and supporting the Allies. But how do you animate a large number of characters without blowing the budget? Frédéric Hein, lead 3D artist at Blindflug Studios, demonstrates how animation for “Ground of Aces” is created and integrated using a wide range of tools.

prg3588.title: Next Gen Ani – Input: Stop Motion: Von der Idee zum Film
prg3588.synopsis: How are stop-motion films made? Stop-motion animator, director and cinematographer Marco Jöger offers insights into the broad spectrum of his work – including scenes from “Sauvages” (2024), “Double or Nothing” (2025) and “Vers la forêt” (2026).

prg3523.title: Game Pop-up
prg3523.synopsis: The Game Pop-up provides aspiring game developers with a platform to present their creations to the public in an exhibition at Trafo Baden. Immerse yourself in this creative vision of new digital worlds and discover a wide variety of indie games!

prg3587.title: Next Gen Ani
prg3587.synopsis: The new generation of Swiss animated films is here! Check out a selection of short films from the last festival edition and from the Swiss Youth Film Festival archive. Join the conversation about the theme of stop motion and embrace the opportunity to chat and connect with others during the drinks reception afterwards.

films.title: 2020: Odyssee im Weltraum
films.credit: 2020: Odyssee im Weltraum, Rachim Jau, CH 2019
films.synopsis: An astronaut and his robot land on a dangerous planet and are swallowed by it. Can they escape the monsters inside?

films.title: Mund auf!
films.credit: Mund auf!, Linus Spiegel, CH 2025
films.synopsis: A visit to the dentist takes an unexpected turn.

films.title: Amigs Hani Angscht
films.credit: Amigs Hani Angscht, Jiani Fei, CH 2025
films.synopsis: When a young woman is asked to speak in front of a crowd, panic overwhelms her. Will she find the courage to face her fear on a journey among fish and stars?

films.title: The Stain
films.credit: The Stain, Maurice Dietziker, CH 2021
films.synopsis: A Lego stop-motion film: During a routine patrol through the corridors of a spaceship, a cleaner discovers a stain that cannot simply be wiped away.

films.title: Tonatiuh
films.credit: Tonatiuh, Marco Jörger, CH 2017
films.synopsis: The priest of an ancient sun cult crosses the wasteland of his lost planet in search of enlightenment for his people and himself.

films.title: La Promesse d'une Utopie
films.credit: The Promise of a Utopia, Mélodie Shannon Jordan, FR 2025
films.synopsis: In a utopian biotechnological future, Véga uses holograms to revisit the decision that led her to give up her dream life and work on a revolutionary project.

films.title: Vegnir ord la calorgna
films.credit: Vegnir ord calorgna, Hadrian Decurtins, CH 2025
films.synopsis: “Vegnir ord la calorgna”, Romansh for “getting up”, tells the story of discovering a passion in the form of an animated short film.

films.title: Das Grosse Rennen von Nonaco
films.credit: Das Grosse Rennen von Nonaco, Max Abegg, Beda Abegg, CH 2025
films.synopsis: Anything goes in the Great Race of Nonaco. As the starting signal sounds, a race with unforeseen events begins ...

prg3524.title: Let's Talk: Big Players
prg3524.synopsis: AATB treat robotics like a material – flexible, unpredictable, almost tender. The duo, Andrea Anner and Thibault Brevet, pushes industrial automation far beyond factory logic, transforming robotic arms into performers, collaborators and sometimes awkward companions.

prg3594.title: VJ.EXE Arena Workshop for Beginners
prg3594.synopsis: The workshop provides you with a practical introduction to the world of live visuals. In about three hours, you will develop your own VJ performance – from the initial idea to gathering image and video material and bringing it to life using Resolume software. The workshop is designed for beginners and anyone interested in this area – no prior experience is required.

prg3419.title: Making-of: «Allah n'est past obligé»
prg3419.synopsis: French filmmaker Zaven Najjar took on the challenge of directing the adaptation of the novel “Allah Is Not Obliged”. His aim was, on the one hand, to highlight the terrible plight of child soldiers and, on the other, to turn the pacifist manifesto into a film that is bothsombre and funny.

prg3533.title: Joanna Quinn: Drawing Beryl: A Love Triangle
prg3533.synopsis: After four hilarious, authentic, absurd, entertaining and expressive films starring Beryl and her uncompromising femininity in lush and sensitive lines – there is now a book! Spanning the years 1987 to 2021, this biography of Beryl’s life highlights the creative process of inseparable trio Beryl, Joanna and Les. With plenty of drawings, of course, and insights into the writing, inspiration, design, drawing, animation, technological progress and red carpets walked by the extroverted English Grande Damegrand lady of animation. Time to see forever-young Beryl remastered on the silver screen, with an introduction by and interview with the creator.

films.title: Girls Night Out
films.credit: Girls Night Out, Joanna Quinn, UK 1987
films.synopsis: Joanna Quinn’s biting comedy is one of the first feminist animated shorts and well and truly turns the tables: a group of friends enjoy a girls’ night out and visit a strip club. Spare a thought for the stripper!

films.title: Body Beautiful
films.credit: Body Beautiful, Joanna Quinn, UK 1991

films.title: Dreams & Desires – Family Ties
films.credit: Dreams & Desires – Family Ties, Joanna Quinn, UK 2006

films.title: Affairs of the Art
films.credit: Affairs of the Art, Joanna Quinn, UK 2020
films.synopsis: How many obsessions can one family have? Beryl reveals her own obsession with drawing, as well as those of her eccentric working-class family – including pickling, screw threads and pet taxidermy.

prg4319.title: Never Gonna GIF You Up! mit Bit.Tuner • DJ Sunhillow • VJ Loov • Jamira Estrada
prg4319.synopsis: They may be small, but there are many GIFs that we’d never wanna give up! These weird and wonderful short animations take their due place on the big screen, where they will be accompanied by a live soundtrack from Bit-Turner Afterwards, we’ll dance to visuals by VJ Loov with DJ Sunhillow. The grand finale will be presented by Jamira Estrada.

prg3589.title: Midnight Snack: We Are Human, After All
prg3589.synopsis: “We Are Human, After All” brings together animated shorts that celebrate humanity through animals, ghostly spirits and unconventional figures. Fragile, playful, stubborn, dreamy and sometimes ridiculously funny, they comprise a cute, bittersweet selection of characters who reflect the soul of the smallest Swiss animation film festival in Savigny.

films.title: Un jour si blanc
films.credit: Un jour si blanc, Vasily Chirkov, RU 2022
films.synopsis: The house, the garden, the old rusty basin, the wind… everything has its mystery and its soul. Children know how to sense it.

films.title: Shackle
films.credit: Shackle, Ainslie Henderson, UK 2022
films.synopsis: Three woodland spirits explore theconflicting, archetypal human drives of creativity, possessiveness and our desire for status.

films.title: Coincé
films.credit: Stuck, Violette Talalaeff, FR 2021
films.synopsis: A man can stop and restart time with a snap of his fingers, until one day time no longer starts again.

films.title: Hot Singles in Your Area
films.credit: Hot Singles in your Area, Nicolás Petelski, ES 2022
films.synopsis: True love will find you in the end.

films.title: Pénélope
films.credit: Penelope, Heta Jäälinoja, EE/FI 2016
films.synopsis: Doorbellrings. Someone is at the door. But everything's a mess.

films.title: Kukuschka
films.credit: Kukuschka, Dina Velikovskaya, DE 2017
films.synopsis: Kukuschkais a bird, who follows the Sun. It seems to her as if she already could touch It, but the Sun is still far away. Suddenly she is not alone anymore, but for two it's even more difficult to keep going so fast. She will reach the Sun, may be tomorrow may be the day after.

films.title: We're Human, After All
films.credit: We're Human, After All, Jan Mika, CZ 2018
films.synopsis: During a harsh winter, the hare must face the freezing cold, hunger and the dangers of hunters and other animals. One day he finds out what a good, comfortable and safe life rabbits lead.

films.title: Python and Guard
films.credit: Phyton and Guard, Anton Dyakov, RU 2015
films.synopsis: A story about friendship and adventures of two, at first glance, incompatible characters: a zookeeper and a python.

films.title: Space Dan
films.credit: Space Dan, Adrien Blanchard, Théophile Farant, Matéo Grossi, Pablo Jegado, Lucas Rougé, FR 2025
films.director: Adrien Blanchard, Théophile Farant, Matéo Grossi, Pablo Jegado, Lucas Rougé
films.synopsis: Dan, a space billionaire, celebrates his birthday in his private space station when a cake accident ruins the party. After aiming for the stars, it’s hard to come back down to earth.

prg3574.title: Kids for Kids
prg3574.synopsis: Young directors aged under 12 show off their artistic talent in an inspiring programme that expresses their wild and unbridled creativity. We will award a selection of prizes among those takingpart.

prg3593.title: Kurzfilme in der Kirche
prg3593.synopsis: There are two questions to be answered here: How do we talk to one another? And how do we interact with each other? Two animated films explore these questions further: “Ebb and Flow” portrays a couple who can no longer speak to one another, while “Splitted” questions whether it is possible to break free from our tendency to think in black and white.

films.title: Splitted
films.credit: Splitted, Mia Lynn Ruhstaller, CH 2024
films.synopsis: Two figures in a divided world of black and white: trapped on their respective sides, they desperately try to break out and reach each other. “Splitted” reveals our tendency to see the world in opposites.

films.title: Ebb and Flow
films.credit: Ebb and Flow, Živa Divjak, CZ 2025
films.synopsis: A young couple’s relationship is put to the test by their difficulties incommunicating. Will they manage to reach out to each other and find a true sense of togetherness? Will they find a path towards reconciliation?

prg3580.title: Toons by Teens
prg3580.synopsis: The “Toons by Teens” programme presents outstanding animated works by young people aged 13 to 17 on the big screen. We will award a selection of prizes among the talented young people taking part.

prg3591.title: Workshop: Scratch mit Cool Code – Create Your Own Game
prg3591.synopsis: Create your first animated game in just three hours and learn the basics of Scratch – the visually intuitive programming language that’s ideal for beginners. The Cool Code programming school will support you in bring your ideas to life – creatively, playfully and open to everyone. No prior knowledge required. For adults and young people aged 14 and over. Please bring your own laptop (or iPad).

prg3555.title: Best of Fantoche
prg3555.synopsis: Four panels of judges and the audience have evaluated and selected their favourite films in this year’s competition. A selection of the award-winning films will be shown after the prize-giving ceremony – don’t miss it!
